QuestInfo.name: Kylan's Research
QuestInfo.0: Ask #p3000003# at the #m400000001# about his research.
QuestInfo.2: #p3000003# told you about the #b#t4033370##k. Return to #b#p3000001##k.

0.0: #p3000001# said you would come. You need the research we've been doing, yes? Just a moment.

yes.0: Please wait... I left one of the findings elsewhere. I'll bring it right away.

no.0: You really do have to wait. This is more complicated than you might think.

1.0: According to my research, the Nova seal ritual used on the castle gate is based on life energy. In a sense, #b#t4033370##k is the core of it all.
1.1: I have information on how to carry out the ritual and the energy needed for it, but... I couldn't find anything on extracting the Life Spark.
1.2: I believe this is worthy of reporting to #b#p3000001##k. As for the details, I'll deliver them to #b#p3000001##k later.
